title: Send the order to the lab or move it to the next stage
summary: Move an order to the next stage. When it is sent to the lab, the due date (and the lab, if missing) is asked for.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Search for the order
steps.details: By patient, job, lab or order number.

steps.title: Open the order
steps.details: Click it in the list. Its details open on the right.

steps.title: Current stage
steps.details: Where the order is, how many days it has been there and its progress through the stages.

steps.title: Send to the lab
steps.details: If the order is in the initial stage (or has no lab), the send window opens.

steps.title: Move to the next stage
steps.details: The order was already sent: the change is saved when you click, with no questions.

steps.title: Lab
steps.details: Only if the order has no lab yet. The list starts filtered by its services’ category.

steps.title: Due date
steps.details: The date the lab promised. From the next day on, if it has not reached a final stage, the order is overdue and an alert goes out.

steps.title: Stage history
steps.details: The change is recorded with the user, the date and how long the order spent in the previous stage.
